D: A skinny Brooklyn kid becomes a super soldier and takes on Hydra in the Second World War.
P: Serve the snacks when Steve and Bucky go to the Stark Expo.
S: Grilled hot dogs with yellow mustard and warm sauerkraut
Franks grilled until split, in soft buns with mustard and sauerkraut, wrapped in wax paper.

Pretzel dough shaped into knots, boiled in bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with mustard. Mix 500g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp salt, 40g melted butter and 300ml warm water and knead 5 minutes. Rise 1 hour. Divide into 8, roll into long ropes and twist into pretzel knots. Boil 2L water with 60g bicarb and dip each pretzel for 20 seconds. Lay on lined trays, brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with rock salt. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes until deep brown. Serve warm with hot English and American mustard.
Aged cheddar, ham, pickled onions, chutney and crusty bread
A board of aged cheddar, sliced ham, pickled onions, tomato chutney and thick slices of crusty bread with butter.
M: Beef chuck stewed with carrots, onion and potatoes
Beef chuck simmered 3 hours with onion, carrot and potato in stock until thick, ladled into tin bowls with bread.
Peggy's chicken, leek and ham pie
Peggy Carter and the Strategic Scientific Reserve

Chicken, leek and ham pie in a creamy sauce under puff pastry, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Brown 800g diced chicken thigh in butter and set aside. Soften 2 sliced leeks in the pan, stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 300ml chicken stock and 150ml cream and simmer until thick. Add the chicken, 150g diced ham and chopped tarragon and season. Tip into a pie dish, cover with 1 sheet puff pastry, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden. Serve with buttered peas.
W: Cherry and blueberry pie with a woven lattice top
Cherries and blueberries cooked with sugar and cornflour, baked in shortcrust with a lattice top at 190C for 45 minutes.
K: Vanilla ice cream, milk and malted milk powder

Cold milk blended with vanilla ice cream and malted milk powder until thick and frothy, served in tall soda fountain glasses. Blend 1L cold milk with 4 scoops vanilla ice cream and 5 tbsp malted milk powder until frothy. Pour into 4 tall glasses. Serve straight away while it is still ice cold.

steps.text: Warm the sauerkraut with the caraway seeds.
Grill the franks until they split.
Tuck into the buns with mustard and sauerkraut and wrap in wax paper.
Cut the cheddar into wedges and slice the bread thickly.
Lay the cheese, ham, onions and chutney on a board with the bread and butter.
Dice the onion, carrots and potatoes.
Brown the beef in batches in oil.
Add the vegetables and stock and simmer until thick and tender.
Ladle into bowls and serve with crusty bread.
Toss the fruit with the sugar and cornflour.
Line a pie dish with pastry, fill, and weave a lattice from the rest.
Rest the pie, then serve warm with ice cream.
Blend the milk, ice cream and malted milk powder until frothy.
Pour into the glasses and serve straight away.

s.note: Grilled hot dogs with yellow mustard and warm sauerkraut
s.how: Warm 300g sauerkraut with a pinch of caraway seeds. Grill 8 hot dog franks until they split. Tuck into soft buns with yellow mustard and sauerkraut and wrap in wax paper. Eat them at the world's fair, 1943.

s.note: Aged cheddar, ham, pickled onions, chutney and crusty bread
s.how: Lay wedges of aged cheddar, sliced ham, a bowl of pickled onions and a pot of tomato chutney on a board. Add thick slices of crusty bread and butter. A ploughman's lunch at a London pub between missions.

m.note: Beef chuck stewed with carrots, onion and potatoes
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, then add a sliced onion, 3 carrots and 600g potato chunks with 1L beef stock. Simmer for 3 hours until thick and tender. Ladle into tin bowls with crusty bread, army style.

w.note: Cherry and blueberry pie with a woven lattice top
w.how: Toss 400g frozen cherries and 200g blueberries with 100g sugar and 3 tbsp cornflour. Line a pie dish with shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice. Bake at 190C for 45 minutes until bubbling. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: Vanilla ice cream, milk and malted milk powder
d.how: Blend 1L cold milk with 4 scoops vanilla ice cream and 5 tbsp malted milk powder until frothy. Pour into 4 tall glasses. Serve straight away while it is still ice cold.
